summary_markdown: A user reported that the staging analytics URL was returning a 500 error when accessed by an administrator without impersonation. A colleague acknowledged the issue, attributing it to missing a required release branch merge. The colleague subsequently deployed changes, resolving conflicts and merging all necessary branches. The updated code is expected to be on staging within three minutes.
decisions: The deployment of the correct release branch was completed.
action_items: Monitor the staging environment for successful resolution of the 500 error.
